mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_study_plan_task (plan_id, user_id, task_date, topic, type, estimated_minutes, completed, sort_order) VALUES (#{planId}, #{userId}, #{taskDate}, #{topic}, #{type}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{completed}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, user_id, task_date, topic, type, estimated_minutes, completed, completed_at, sort_order FROM sa_study_plan_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY task_date ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_study_plan_task SET completed = #{completed}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} = 1 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{taskId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_study_plan_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND completed = 0
